key_highlights: David Jones collapses into voluntary administration, threatening mall tenancy profiles and retail supply chains.
Strait of Hormuz conflict escalates, spiking jet fuel and crude costs; Qantas flags a $1B fuel surge and cuts capacity.
ASX dips late but closes higher for the week (^AXJO), supported by strong equity raisings across gold and critical minerals.
Housing market indicators flash warning signs as reduced borrowing capacity and sluggish GDP growth heighten downside risks for mortgage lenders.

sectors.trend: Severe headwinds as landmark department store collapses; retail foot traffic and anchor tenancy models under threat.
sectors.implications: Elevated vacancy and leasing renegotiation risks for retail landlords (SCG.AX, VCX.AX); severe trade credit losses for fashion and homeware suppliers.

sectors.trend: Middle East supply disruption elevates oil benchmarks, translating to severe margin compression for transport and upside for upstream energy.
sectors.implications: Airlines (QAN.AX) forced to lift airfares and trim capacity due to $1B fuel hit; upstream domestic producers (WDS.AX, STO.AX) benefit from elevated realised hydrocarbon pricing.

sectors.trend: Gold capital raisings surge amid strong liquidity, while junior battery metals and critical minerals exploration restarts.
sectors.implications: Strong equity support for gold producers (NST.AX, EVN.AX) as geopolitical safe-haven demand solidifies bullion prices; speculative interest returns to critical minerals (CHN.AX, BPM.AX).

sectors.trend: Divergence between resilient banking balance sheets and accelerating residential property price drops driven by constrained borrowing capacity.
sectors.implications: Major banks (CBA.AX, WBC.AX, NAB.AX, ANZ.AX) face slowing loan growth and rising mortgage provisioning risks as property markets cool under restrictive RBA cash rate settings.

sectors.trend: Selective outperformance in AI infrastructure and data centre operators despite broader economic stagnation.
sectors.implications: Structural growth themes support valuations for data centre providers (NXT.AX) even as corporate governance and advertising revenues drag traditional media (NEC.AX).

key_themes: Stagflationary pressures: slowing domestic GDP alongside imported energy cost shocks.
Structural retail shift: failure of legacy department stores accelerating mall redevelopments.
Safe-haven commodities: gold appetite buffering broader equities market volatility.

risk_assessment.mitigation: Hedge transport exposure via long upstream oil/LNG producers (WDS.AX) and underweight fuel-sensitive transport names.
Underweight retail REITs reliant on department store anchors (SCG.AX, VCX.AX); rotate into logistics and digital infrastructure.
Monitor RBA policy stance, bank net interest margins, and arrears rates; favour diversified commercial lenders over pure-play residential lenders.
Allocate to non-cyclical defensive earners such as healthcare (CSL.AX) and global resource exporters.

opportunities.rationale: Bullion prices supported by Strait of Hormuz conflict and active institutional capital raisings providing balance sheet strength.

opportunities.recommendation: Selective Exposure to Digital Infrastructure and Energy
opportunities.rationale: High structural demand for cloud/AI capacity and strong cash flows from higher energy benchmarks.

defensive_moves.recommendation: Underweight Retail Landlords and Consumer Discretionary
defensive_moves.rationale: David Jones collapse triggers tenant renegotiations, vacancy spikes, and consumer spending pullbacks.
Escalating jet fuel costs impose severe earnings headwinds, forcing fare hikes and capacity reductions.

market_outlook.short_term: Range-bound ASX 200 (^AXJO) trading between 8,100–8,350 as energy and mining gains offset weakness in consumer discretionary, retail REITs, and aviation.
market_outlook.long_term: Subdued medium-term growth driven by housing debt deleveraging and cautious consumer balance sheets, contingent on RBA easing timing and China resource demand.
key_catalysts: RBA monetary policy statement and cash rate decision
